title: Rename the burn flag in the drop info response
body: Shorter field name in GET /drops/:id. The e2e test is updated.

source.note: Planted by the user (original title "breaking change"). Its real parent 53e6cdc only differs in apps/api/src/lib/format.ts, so it is reviewed on 892ddf8 to keep one bug per case.

note: The API renames burnAfterDownload to burnOnce in GET /drops/:id; the web app still reads burnAfterDownload.

expected.description: GET /drops/:id now returns burnOnce instead of burnAfterDownload, but the web app (types/drop.ts, shared-bundle-card.tsx, shared-file-card.tsx, unlock-card.tsx) still reads drop.burnAfterDownload: burn-after-download links look like normal links, previews and per-file downloads are offered and then refused.
